parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Egwi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Egwi
Curve type: AAA-type ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5$)
Aquifer depth: 6.29 m – 44.25 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of 45 to 50 m to fully exploit the thick, saturated sand layer (Layer 4) before terminating above the highly resistive lower formation. Ensure screen placement within the 15–40 m interval with appropriate gravel packing to maximize yield and prevent fine sand entry.
